p.src: 1  “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

en: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.
u.src: 1  “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

p.src: 2  Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

en: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
u.src: 2  Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

p.src: 3  “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

en: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
u.src: 3  “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

p.src: 4  For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

en: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.
u.src: 4  For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

p.src: 5  He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

en: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.
u.src: 5  He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

p.src: 6  “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

en: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
u.src: 6  “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

p.src: 7  My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

en: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
u.src: 7  My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

p.src: 8  Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

en: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
u.src: 8  Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

p.src: 9  Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

en: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
u.src: 9  Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

p.src: 10  But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

en: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
u.src: 10  But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

p.src: 11  My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

en: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
u.src: 11  My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

p.src: 12  They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

en: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
u.src: 12  They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

p.src: 13  If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

en: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
u.src: 13  If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

en: 17:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 14  if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

en: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
u.src: 14  if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

p.src: 15  where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

en: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?
u.src: 15  where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

p.src: 16  Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

en: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
u.src: 16  Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

en: 17:16 Sheol is the place of the dead.
